hooks.command: P=$(cat); case "$P" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$R/agent-worker/test_sidecar.py" ] || exit 0; PY="$R/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$R/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wt-precommit-$$-$RANDOM"; mkdir -p "$T" || exit 0; (cd "$R/agent-worker" && LOG_TO_FILE=0 SETTINGS_PATH="$T/s.json" SECRETS_PATH="$T/x.json" ADMIN_AUTH_PATH="$T/a.json" CALLS_PATH="$T/c" "$PY" -m unittest test_sidecar >"$T/out.txt" 2>&1); S=$?; rm -rf "$T" 2>/dev/null; [ $S -eq 0 ] && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"test_sidecar is red, so this commit was blocked. CI runs the same suite before building an image, so it would not have shipped anyway. Run the suite (see the wavetalk-test skill), fix the failures, then commit again."},"systemMessage":"Commit blocked: test_sidecar is failing."}'
